會、會痛也沒關係……我要變強。: I-it's okay if it hurts... I want to get stronger.
代價我看清楚了。就拿這個。: I've seen the cost clearly. I'll take this one.
先寄放在師父這裡，見面再拿回來喵。: I'll leave it with Master for now and take it back when we meet, meow.
毒針袋……先放在這裡。師父，您幫我顧著。: The Poison Dart Pouch... I'll leave it here for now. Master, please look after it for me.
換。我自己的東西，回去還能再打一對。: Swap. It's my own gear — I can forge another pair when I'm back.
劍穗先押在這裡。回來再拿。: I'll leave the Old Sword Tassel here as collateral. I'll take it back when I return.
師父的護腕……上面的紫氣好冰喵。我一定會把它洗乾淨喵。: Master's wrist guard... the purple miasma on it feels so cold, meow. I'll definitely wash it clean, meow.
這是師父的……摸起來好冷。我、我會想辦法把它弄乾淨。: This is Master's... it feels so cold to the touch. I-I'll find a way to clean it.
大俠貓的護腕。沾了魔氣，還能用。回頭我把它清乾淨。: The Master's wrist guard. Miasma-stained, but still usable. I'll clean it up later.
沾了魔氣的貨。我先帶著，路上找地方洗。: Miasma-stained goods. I'll carry them for now and find somewhere to wash them on the road.
閉著眼睛拿，拿到什麼都算我的喵！: I'll grab with my eyes closed — whatever I get counts as mine, meow!
看不到裡面，就摸摸看。: Can't see inside, so I'll just feel around.
沒得挑的貨，也得收。: Goods with no choice in the matter — I have to take them anyway.
